CREATE TRIGGER saved_meal_items_stamp_forward
  AFTER UPDATE OF updated_at ON saved_meal_items
  WHEN NEW.dirty = 1 AND NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at
BEGIN
  UPDATE saved_meal_items SET updated_at = OLD.updated_at + 1
    WHERE id = NEW.id;
END;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("id" = 1), "birth_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "sex" TEXT NULL, "height_cm" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("height_cm" BETWEEN 100.0 AND 250.0), "activity_level" TEXT NOT NULL, "diet_type" TEXT NULL, "training_place" TEXT NULL, "experience" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER profiles_stamp_forward AFTER UPDATE OF updated_at ON profiles WHEN NEW.dirty = 1 AND NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at BEGIN UPDATE profiles SET updated_at = OLD.updated_at + 1 WHERE id = NEW.id;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_weight_kg" REAL NULL CHECK("target_weight_kg" BETWEEN 20.0 AND 400.0), "basis_weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("basis_weight_kg" BETWEEN 20.0 AND 400.0), "calories_kcal" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("calories_kcal" BETWEEN 1200 AND 10000), "protein_g" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("protein_g" >= 0), "carbs_g" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("carbs_g" >= 0), "fat_g" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("fat_g" >= 0), "water_ml" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("water_ml" > 0), "steps" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("steps" > 0), "formula_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= started_at));

CREATE TRIGGER goals_stamp_forward AFTER UPDATE OF updated_at ON goals WHEN NEW.dirty = 1 AND NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at BEGIN UPDATE goals SET updated_at = OLD.updated_at + 1 WHERE id = NEW.id;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weight_logs" ("dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("weight_kg" BETWEEN 20.0 AND 400.0), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER weight_logs_stamp_forward AFTER UPDATE OF updated_at ON weight_logs WHEN NEW.dirty = 1 AND NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at BEGIN UPDATE weight_logs SET updated_at = OLD.updated_at + 1 WHERE id = NEW.id;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_entries" ("dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal" TEXT NOT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "portion_unit" TEXT NULL, "portion_count" REAL NULL CHECK("portion_count" > 0.0 AND "portion_count" <= 5000.0), "oil_level" TEXT NULL, "grams" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("grams" > 0.0 AND "grams" <= 5000.0), "kcal" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("kcal" BETWEEN 0.0 AND 10000.0), "protein_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("protein_g" >= 0.0), "carbs_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("carbs_g" >= 0.0), "fat_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("fat_g" >= 0.0), "eaten_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER meal_entries_stamp_forward AFTER UPDATE OF updated_at ON meal_entries WHEN NEW.dirty = 1 AND NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at BEGIN UPDATE meal_entries SET updated_at = OLD.updated_at + 1 WHERE id = NEW.id;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_meals" ("dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER saved_meals_stamp_forward AFTER UPDATE OF updated_at ON saved_meals WHEN NEW.dirty = 1 AND NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at BEGIN UPDATE saved_meals SET updated_at = OLD.updated_at + 1 WHERE id = NEW.id;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_meal_items" ("dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "saved_meal_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "portion_unit" TEXT NULL, "portion_count" REAL NULL CHECK("portion_count" > 0.0 AND "portion_count" <= 5000.0), "oil_level" TEXT NULL, "grams" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("grams" > 0.0 AND "grams" <= 5000.0), "kcal" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("kcal" BETWEEN 0.0 AND 10000.0), "protein_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("protein_g" >= 0.0), "carbs_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("carbs_g" >= 0.0), "fat_g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("fat_g" >= 0.0), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("sort_order" BETWEEN 0 AND 200), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER saved_meal_items_stamp_forward AFTER UPDATE OF updated_at ON saved_meal_items WHEN NEW.dirty = 1 AND NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at BEGIN UPDATE saved_meal_items SET updated_at = OLD.updated_at + 1 WHERE id = NEW.id;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "health_samples" ("dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "metric" TEXT NOT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("value" >= 0.0), "measured_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((metric = 'water_ml' AND value <= 5000) OR (metric = 'steps' AND value <= 100000)));

CREATE TRIGGER health_samples_stamp_forward AFTER UPDATE OF updated_at ON health_samples WHEN NEW.dirty = 1 AND NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at BEGIN UPDATE health_samples SET updated_at = OLD.updated_at + 1 WHERE id = NEW.id;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "foods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "aliases_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "kcal_per_100g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("kcal_per_100g" BETWEEN 0.0 AND 900.0), "protein_g_per_100g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("protein_g_per_100g" BETWEEN 0.0 AND 100.0), "carbs_g_per_100g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("carbs_g_per_100g" BETWEEN 0.0 AND 100.0), "fat_g_per_100g" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("fat_g_per_100g" BETWEEN 0.0 AND 100.0), "portions_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "assumption" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (protein_g_per_100g + carbs_g_per_100g + fat_g_per_100g <= 100.5));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursors" ("kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("kind"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_account" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("id" = 1), "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "bound_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX foods_name ON foods (name)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX goals_one_active ON goals ((ended_at IS NULL)) WHERE ended_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX weight_logs_one_a_day ON weight_logs (day) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX meal_entries_eaten_at ON meal_entries (eaten_at)
CREATE INDEX meal_entries_day ON meal_entries (day)
CREATE INDEX saved_meal_items_meal ON saved_meal_items (saved_meal_id, sort_order)
CREATE INDEX health_samples_metric_time ON health_samples (metric, measured_at)
CREATE INDEX health_samples_day_metric ON health_samples (day, metric)
